title: Pullback square for explicit normalized integral presentation maps
statement: Given normalized CoefficientPresentation records C T for every scheme T, the explicit maps (C T).integralMap satisfy the inverse-image square for every scheme morphism.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; finite quotient pullback comparison

proof.text: Compose both sides with every finite quotient projection. The finite constant and residue normalizations identify the resulting pointwise maps, and the completed inverse-limit projections are jointly monic.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; finite quotient pullback comparison

lean.statement: theorem coefficient_presentation_integralMap_pull_square [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] PadicAlgCl l) (C : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, CoefficientPresentation l T E i) : ∀ {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V), ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull g).hom ≫ (C U).integralMap l U = (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map ((C V).integralMap l V) ≫ ((nativeCoefficients l).pull g).hom
